request.query: An integral element over a commutative ring has monic annihilating polynomials of arbitrarily large degree

items.name: Algebra.IsIntegral
items.type: (R : Type u_1) → (A : Type u_3) → [inst : CommRing R] → [inst_1 : Ring A] → [Algebra R A] → Prop

items.name: IsIntegral
items.type: (R : Type u_1) → {A : Type u_3} → [inst : CommRing R] → [inst_1 : Ring A] → [Algebra R A] → A → Prop

items.name: minpoly.IsIntegrallyClosed.degree_le_of_ne_zero
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [IsDomain R] [inst_3 : Algebra R S]
  [IsIntegrallyClosed R] [IsDomain S] [Module.IsTorsionFree R S] {s : S} {p : Polynomial R},
  p ≠ 0 → (Polynomial.aeval s) p = 0 → (minpoly R s).degree ≤ p.degree

items.name: RingHom.IsIntegralElem
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → {A : Type u_3} → [inst : CommRing R] → [inst_1 : Ring A] → (R →+* A) → A → Prop

items.name: minpoly.monic
items.type:
∀ {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : Ring B] [inst_2 : Algebra A B] {x : B},
  IsIntegral A x → (minpoly A x).Monic

items.name: Polynomial.exists_monic_aeval_eq_zero_forall_mem_pow_of_isIntegral
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S] {I : Ideal R} {x : S},
  IsIntegral (↥(Algebra.adjoin R {x | ∃ r ∈ I, Polynomial.C r * Polynomial.X = x})) (Polynomial.C x * Polynomial.X) →
    ∃ p, p.Monic ∧ (Polynomial.aeval x) p = 0 ∧ ∀ (i : ℕ), p.coeff i ∈ I ^ (p.natDegree - i)

items.name: IsIntegral.of_aeval_monic
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A] {x : A}
  {p : Polynomial R}, p.Monic → p.natDegree ≠ 0 → IsIntegral R ((Polynomial.aeval x) p) → IsIntegral R x

items.name: integralClosure.isIntegral
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A]
  (x : ↥(integralClosure R A)), IsIntegral R x
